# GRUB theme for the IYAKKI boot menu: the logo picture fills the screen; the menu sits below the emblem.
# (If this theme cannot be loaded, GRUB shows the plain menu over iyakki-bg.png or on black.)
title-text: ""
desktop-image: "iyakki-bg.png"
desktop-image-scale-method: "padding"
desktop-color: "#050710"
terminal-font: "GNU Unifont Regular 16"
# GRUB's terminal window, which it paints (in background_color, set in grub.cfg to the desktop colour) when an entry starts and
# while it loads the kernel: below the emblem, over the menu, so the logo stays on screen until IYAKKI's boot screen takes over
# at the same place. GRUB makes it at least 80 x 24 characters (640 x 384 pixels with this font) and centres it when the
# room given is smaller, so it stays clear of the logo on screens 1080 pixels high or more; on smaller ones it covers the
# middle in the desktop colour (never the black box over the logo, never the menu left behind).
terminal-left: "0"
terminal-top: "61%"
terminal-width: "100%"
terminal-height: "39%"
terminal-border: "0"

+ boot_menu {
	left = 14%
	top = 61%
	width = 72%
	height = 34%
	item_font = "GNU Unifont Regular 16"
	selected_item_font = "GNU Unifont Regular 16"
	item_color = "#9aa6c8"
	selected_item_color = "#46e1ff"
	item_height = 22
	item_padding = 3
	item_spacing = 1
	scrollbar = true
}

+ label {
	left = 0
	top = 95%
	width = 100%
	align = "center"
	font = "GNU Unifont Regular 16"
	color = "#5d6a8f"
	text = "IYAKKI  -  an OS for agents    (Up/Down and Enter choose a start, e edits it)"
}
